records.title: Vacancies of Judges in courts of Kerala
details: The Hon'ble Minister said that Deputy Chairman Sir, this was a question related to the Kerala High Court. The Hon'ble Member has asked the question, so I would like to tell you that the total sanctioned strength of the High Court is 1,114. Out of that, 754 vacancies are filled. Now there are vacant vacancies, the Hon'ble Member is talking about High Court judges, so there are 360. 205 names have come to us from different High Courts collegium and they are under consideration and names have not yet come from the High Court for 155 vacancies. Similarly, they cannot take the name of any judge. Then, as they have said in Kerala, under the vacancy, we have a proposal pending with us, proposal for appointment of four Judicial Officers as judges of Kerala High Court received in Department of Justice on 4th June, 2024. And, the second proposal has two names, one advocate and one judicial officer, recommended by the Supreme Court Collegium on 10.10.2023 and 16.04.2024 respectively. All that is under consideration and decisions will be taken in this soon.

records.title: PUBLICATION OF THE ANNUAL SURVEY OF INDUSTRIES
details:
(a) to (d): The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation conducts Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) every year. ASI is a major source of data of registered manufacturing sector of the Indian Economy. No results of ASI has been published in 2023.The fieldwork of ASI 2021-22 has been completed in 2023. Further data validation and scrutiny is being done
before release.
